title: Symmetry and normality of the second fundamental form (Simon 4.26), from the chart formula
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝᴺ be an n-dimensional C² Simon submanifold (Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝⁿ) 2 M). Assume (R) for every chart (V, W, ψ) of M of class 2 and every x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x); and (C) for every chart (V, W, ψ) of M of class 2, every x ∈ V and all a, b ∈ ℝⁿ, secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (Dψ(x)a) (Dψ(x)b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (D²ψ(x)[a, b]) [(R) is (TH1) of the node root.submanifold_tangent-a1 restricted to class-2 charts of M; (C) is the conclusion of the node root.stationary_results-a1.sff_chart-a1 for M]. Then for every y ∈ M and all τ, η ∈ tangentSpace M y: secondFundamentalForm M y τ η = secondFundamentalForm M y η τ, and ⟨secondFundamentalForm M y τ η, v⟩ = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M y.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ ψ x a) (fderiv ℝ ψ x b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x a b)) → ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, secondFundamentalForm M y τ η = secondFundamentalForm M y η τ ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M y, inner ℝ (secondFundamentalForm M y τ η) v = 0
